title: Insurance Channel Routing SOP Snippets
scope: Use with channel_router heuristic output for agency, direct, MGA, and partner routing decisions.
disclaimer: These snippets support operations review and do not replace underwriting appetite, licensing, or compliance controls.

agency: Confirm producer appointment, license status, and territory before binding.
Use agency routing when relationship context, coverage advice, or complex service needs are material.
Document why agency commission economics are appropriate for the premium and service model.
direct: Use direct routing for simple, low-touch submissions where digital consent and disclosures are complete.
Escalate out of direct flow when specialty coverage, advice needs, or manual underwriting triggers appear.
Monitor abandonment and quote-to-bind metrics weekly for direct channel health.
mga: Verify MGA delegated authority, program appetite, state eligibility, and capacity before referral.
Use MGA routing for specialty, hard-to-place, or niche product risks with clear submission documentation.
Retain underwriting rationale and referral notes for auditability.
partner: Validate partner source, customer consent, data-sharing permissions, and brand/disclosure requirements.
Use partner routing for affinity, embedded, referral, or bundle-driven products.
Track partner conversion, complaint, and cancellation rates separately from direct traffic.

review_triggers: Top channel score gap below 8 points
Any channel constraint conflicts with the recommended channel
High complexity submission recommended for direct or partner without manual review
MGA recommendation where no active authority or appetite exists
